Thanks Oscar — looping in Karthik (infra lead) and Soojin (security) to help. Attached is a concise sanity checklist we use for private deployments and a short note on where state and secrets should live. High-level summary below; full checklist attached (priv-iac-sanity-checklist.pdf).

Summary (short answers):
- Terraform state: recommended remote state in customer-managed S3-compatible bucket with server-side encryption + Dynamo/consensus lock via customer-provided locking service (we document a minimal S3 + Dynamo/Consul pattern).
- Secrets: avoid storing in Git; use KMS-backed secrets in the customer's KMS/HSM and reference via vault-agent or Kubernetes external-secrets in GitOps. We provide examples for AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and HashiCorp Vault.
- GitOps flow: PR -> CI static checks (lint, tfsec, helm lint) -> plan generation -> review -> signed-off PR merge triggers apply in air-gapped runner inside customer network. We recommend a gated apply with canary namespace first.
- Canary & rollback: < 10% traffic canary with automated health checks (latency, error rate). If health checks fail, automated rollback to prior release and open incident with required log dump. Our playbook has a 3-step manual fallback too.

Action items for us:
1) Karthik and Soojin, can you add any redlines to the checklist for the SOW language (ownership + SLA/rollback)?
2) Oscar, will Lisa (procurement) accept a one-page annex describing rollback responsibilities and a 90-day bug/patch window?

I'll attach the checklist and a one-page 'state & secrets' note.

Thanks — Camila

Adding a few technical redlines and clarifications inline — high level first, then specific bullets to include in the SOW annex:

High level: we are comfortable with a customer-owned state bucket and customer KMS, but we need the contract to call out:
- Read/access controls for any Redwood-run components (e.g., support agents) must be time-limited and auditable.
- Escape hatches: detailed rollback playbook must be included as an annex with runbook steps and primary/secondary contacts.

Technical bullets to add to checklist/SOW annex (please include):
- Terraform: state stored in customer-managed bucket; locking via Dynamo/consul. Plan artifacts must be saved to a signed, immutable object store for audit.
- Helm: charts must be signed (cosign) and verified in the GitOps runner before apply. Chart values containing secrets must be templated to reference external secret refs, not plaintext.
- Ansible: limit ad-hoc tasks; use idempotent roles and run in a bastion inside the customer network.
- CI/CD: CI runners for apply must run on hosts under customer control (air-gapped option). All CI logs and apply outputs must be pushed to a secure, immutable audit log.
- Monitoring & health checks: define SLI thresholds for canary rollouts (p50/p95 latency delta, 5xx rate).

I've created a short note on state handling (attached: tf-state-handling.md) with the recommended S3+lock config and an example policy snippet. Soojin, please add any compliance-level items you want surfaced to procurement.

—Karthik
